2608.25741.title: Why Does Graph Learning Fail to Fully Benefit from a Text Teacher?
2608.25741.paper_summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are widely used to represent complex interactions and relationships among entities. We investigate a multimodal model that combines two complementary ideas: a self-supervised method that enables a GNN encoder pretrained on one dataset to operate directly on another dataset with a different node-feature dimensionality, without rebuilding the model or realigning the data; and an alternating optimization method that updates a language-model module in an E-step and a GNN module in an M-step, rather than jointly training a large language model and a GNN end to end on a large graph. Despite expectations, the combined model did not sufficiently improve predictive performance. We identify six factors: (1) an external anchor in the E-step has a strength-safety trade-off: a weak anchor has little effect, whereas an overly strong anchor can damage the graph representation; (2) the knowledge of the E-step teacher is not injected directly into the GCN embedding Z; (3) the representation space constructed in the M-step is not optimized for the same objective as the E-step teacher space, resulting in a compromise representation for target classification; (4) GCN propagation averages a node's own textual information with information from its neighbors; (5) cosine alignment does not guarantee axes that are discriminative for classification, so stronger geometric alignment with the E-step text anchor need not sufficiently improve the target decision boundary or classification performance; and (6) the force that preserves the source-side self-supervised geometry in the M-step conflicts with the force that moves the representation toward the E-step teacher. We support these observations through a staged set of experiments that varies the influence of the E-step.
2608.25741.paper_summary_zh: 圖神經網絡（GNNs）被廣泛用於表示實體之間的複雜互動和關係。<lb/>我們研究了一種多模態模型，結合了兩個互補的想法：一種自我監督的方法，使得在一個數據集上預訓練的GNN編碼器能夠直接在另一個具有不同節點特徵維度的數據集上運作，而無需重建模型或重新對齊數據；以及一種交替優化方法，在E步驟中更新語言模型模塊，在M步驟中更新GNN模塊，而不是在大型圖上端到端地聯合訓練大型語言模型和GNN。<lb/>儘管有預期，結合模型並未顯著改善預測性能。我們確定了六個因素：（1）E步驟中的外部錨點存在強度與安全性的權衡：弱錨點影響甚微，而過強的錨點可能損害圖的表示；（2）E步驟教師的知識並未直接注入到GCN嵌入Z中；（3）在M步驟中構建的表示空間並未針對與E步驟教師空間相同的目標進行優化，導致目標分類的妥協表示；（4）GCN傳播將節點自身的文本信息與其鄰居的信息進行平均；（5）餘弦對齊並不保證對分類具有區分性的軸，因此與E步驟文本錨點的更強幾何對齊不一定能夠充分改善目標決策邊界或分類性能；（6）在M步驟中保持源端自我監督幾何的力量與將表示移向E步驟教師的力量相矛盾。我們通過一系列分階段的實驗來支持這些觀察，這些實驗變化了E步驟的影響。
2608.25741.author: Fumiaki Kimino et.al.
